Original data initialization changes reviewed: additional dex/cry/experience lookup, additional 87.5-percent female ratio, species bootstrap and biome spawn append.
Generator changes are intentional and authorized; immutable battle/input/save sources are verified separately.
Native integration and GPU visual tests are separate evidence; source hashes cannot prove semantic equivalence.

Second renderer-only review: JohtoRenderer handles composite/inner ledges using Tile direction conventions and matching basalt/snow/mountain cells; BwAssets keeps planted/berry states on their exact fallback and uses the tree-top region for decorative shrubs. Only these two sources changed from the prior freeze.
